title: Smart-Sampayan
description: Traditional sampayan systems rely entirely on manual operation and do not respond to sudden weather changes such as rainfall. As a result, clothes left unattended during rain become wet again, causing inconvenience, additional labor, and inefficiency in household tasks. Furthermore, individuals are often forced to rush and manually retrieve their drying clothes when it suddenly rains, which can be difficult or impossible when they are not at home or immediately available.

title: Smart-Blind-Control
description: Manual window blind operation is often inefficient because users do not adjust blinds continuously in response to changing sunlight and indoor temperature. This causes glare, thermal discomfort, and unnecessary energy use from electric lighting and cooling systems. In many cases, existing commercial automated blind systems are too expensive or too complex for small-scale educational use. Because of this, there is a need for a low-cost closed-loop automated window blind control system that can sense ambient light and indoor temperature, process these conditions in real time, and automatically adjust the blinds through motorized actuation with minimal human intervention.

title: Smart-Dog-Dispenser-Control
description: Many pet owners struggle to maintain consistent feeding and watering schedules for their dogs. Overfeeding or underfeeding can lead to health issues like obesity or malnutrition. Similarly, inconsistent hydration can result in dehydration, affecting the dog’s health. There is a need for an automated system that can monitor both water and food levels in real-time and adjust the dispensation accordingly to meet the dog's dietary needs. Manual feeding and watering also create additional workload for owners, particularly when they are away from home. A smart system can ease this burden and ensure that pets are always fed and hydrated as needed.
